logicalVersusProvider.observation: Source exposes separate operationsPerUsefulResult and providerAttemptsPerUsefulResult. Provider numerator counts all joined recorded attempts for the same filtered logical operations, including unsuccessful dispatches/retries. Ratio is withheld unless requests are nonempty, the capability has useful semantics and all selected logical operations have known attempt capture. Known undispatched operations can contribute zero attempts; missing history is not inferred.

usefulDenominators.observation: Reconstruction efficiency divides by distinct owned accepted rooms across the selected request cohort, not accepted-operation count. Assistant efficiency divides by currently APPLIED edits, not generated proposals. Existing acceptance/Apply rate denominators remain recorded-outcome operations, a separate concept. The account-only reproduction deliberately creates two accepted operations for one owned room and one applied edit with a retry.
